{{Top|leg}}
A '''neural scan''' was a medical procedure. Under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] law, [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] had to undergo periodic neural scans to ensure their [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] units were operating correctly.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
